name: io.github.nero-zng/solana-alpha-x402-mcp
title: Solana Alpha x402
description: Pay-per-call Solana market intel via x402 USDC: price, news, trending, perps, rugcheck, token report, wallet.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Solana private key (base58) used to pay x402 USDC. Without it, tools return readable 402 payment requirements.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_ALPHA_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL override (default https://solana-x402-data.netlify.app).
